body-full.region: the entire figure from crown to feet

headwear.region: the scalp and a generous region immediately above and beside the head

bottom.region: from the waist to the feet, including skirt volume and exposed legs

hair-short.region: the scalp and short hair volume beside the head, ending just below the neck

hair-long.region: the scalp and hair falling beside the face and across the shoulders

face.region: the facial features inside the head; keep the head silhouette and ears unchanged

markings.region: the face only; preserve the eyes, mouth, head shape and skin outside the markings

facial-hair.region: the cheeks, chin and short beard area just below the jaw

top.region: the shirt torso and both complete arms, including the lifted waving arm; keep the head and gloves unchanged

top-dress.region: from the neck through the torso, arms and full dress skirt to the feet

outer-short.region: the jacket torso and complete sleeves, including the lifted waving arm; keep the head and gloves unchanged

outer-long.region: from the neck across the shoulders, arms and full coat or cloak hem

footwear.region: the lower calves, ankles and feet, following each planted or lifted foot

neck.region: around the neck and shoulders with scarf ends over the upper torso

bag.region: the shoulder straps, torso and hip area beside the body for the bag

held.region: the right-hand lantern hanging below the grip, from resting hip height through raised eye height

eyewear.region: the eyes, bridge of the nose and temples for fitted eyewear; preserve the remaining face

hair-shoulder.region: the scalp and hair falling to the shoulders, excluding the lower chest and sleeves

top-long.region: from the neck through torso and arms to the upper thigh for a long tunic
